BL-770 — EPIC — Workflow Canary: refactor the tracer bullet into a named, recorded, operator-run preflight; do not promote directly; tracks children
What it solves: UMBRELLA / tracking item (type: epic), NOT directly promotable — the
coordinator promotes CHILD slices, never this. Children carry
`epic: workflow-canary` and get listed in `decomposes_into`.
Approval context: The human locked six decisions in the intake and explicitly asked the specifier to weigh in on five open ones. Here are my answers; each is a default I will spec against unless you say otherwise, and none is expensive to change before slice A starts.
1. **Seed shape** — keep the existing note-carry…
BL-770 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-770" (or "reject BL-770 <reason>") to act.
